summary: Builds a list of fileglob patterns from a variable with regex_replace and passes it to the fileglob lookup with argument unpacking (*globlist) to copy files per group.
questions: How do I build fileglob patterns dynamically from a list variable?
How can I pass a list as multiple arguments to a lookup?
How do I copy config files for each group from per-group folders?

answer_card.title: Dynamic fileglob from a variable
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- copy:
    src: "{{ item }}"
    dest: "/tmp/{{ item }}"
  loop: '{{ q("fileglob", *globlist) }}'
  vars:
    globlist: '{{ mygroups | map("regex_replace", "^(.*)$", "files/\\1/*.conf") | list }}'
```

The `*` unpacks the list into separate lookup arguments.
